async.description: A hard per-device limit in seconds; with poll: 0 the task runs in the background.

become.description: Run this task's SSH commands as become_user through sudo -n. A block's covers its tasks; the narrowest key wins; false turns off one set above.

become_method.description: Only sudo, run without a password.

become_user.description: The account become runs commands as: root when not given.

changed_when.description: Conditions deciding whether a finished run counts as changed.

check_mode.description: Run this task (and, on a block, its block, rescue and always tasks) in check mode, even in a real run. Only true; false is refused.

delay.description: Seconds between an until task's runs.

failed_when.description: Conditions that fail the task when they hold.

fqcn.description: The action this task performs: an engine keyword or a namespaced Collection method.

ignore_errors.description: Go on past a failure of this task; it is still recorded as one.

listen.description: On a handler: topics it also answers to.

lock_acquisition.description: When this task's device locks are acquired.

loop.description: Run the task once per item: a list, or one {{ }} expression rendering to a list. Read each as {{ item }}.

loop_control.description: loop_var, index_var and label for a loop.

notify.description: Handlers to run when this task changes something: a name or listen topic, or a list of them.

params.description: Arguments passed to fqcn. A string holding {{ }} renders when the task runs, reading vars, nodes and result.

poll.description: With async: seconds between progress reports, or 0 to run in the background.

register.description: Name to store this task's result under.

register_mask.description: Field(s) of this task's own registered result to mask, dotted paths allowed.

retries.description: How many more runs an until task gets.

rollback.description: This task's authored undo: plain method calls a rollback runs on each device the task changed, in place of the undo its method recorded. An empty list says undoing the task means doing nothing. Only on a method call; each step is a method and its params, with no target, register, conditions or tags.

rollback_on_failure.description: On a block: when one of its own tasks fails on a device, undo what its tasks completed there, newest first, before its rescue starts, journaled as a rollback of each. Only on a block, and only over tasks whose undo is exact.

secret_mask.description: Retroactively masks fields of an earlier task's registered result.

tags.description: Names --tags and --skip-tags select this task by. On a block or parallel group they pass down to every task inside.

timeout.description: Ansible's timeout: whole seconds this task may run on each device before it is stopped and fails, as a number (1800) or a duration of whole seconds (150s, 30m, 1h30m); 0 or none is no bound of its own. Only on a method call.

until.description: Run the task again until these conditions hold, over its own result under its register.

vars.description: Variables for this task (or every task in a block), read as {{ vars.name }}. The narrower scope wins.

when.description: Ansible-compatible conditional, ANDed if a list.

when_or.description: Conditional, ORed if a list. No Ansible equivalent.

within.description: The device name or tag a target rendered from data must stay inside. Required beside a params.target holding {{ }}, refused anywhere else, and written literally.

description: The native Pleiades automation format. Not an Ansible playbook: a top-level YAML list is rejected.

become.description: Run every task's SSH commands as become_user through sudo -n, unless a block or task says otherwise.

become_method.description: Only sudo, run without a password.

become_user.description: The account become runs commands as: root when not given.

check_mode.description: Make the whole run a check. Only true; false is refused.

hosts.description: Default target for a task that does not set its own.

id.description: The runbook's own identifier. Embedded into a NATS subject, so restricted to this character set.

metadata.description: Pleiades-only facts about the runbook as a whole.

category.description: The one catalog bucket this runbook is filed under.

description.description: A sentence or two about what this runbook does.

interruptible.description: A Runner that loses its Controller may abort this run. Omitted means true.

labels.description: Free-form catalog filter markers. Not Ansible tags.

service_effecting.description: Running this can affect live service.

reversible.description: Promise that a rollback can undo every task that changes a device; validation refuses the runbook otherwise, naming each task that would break the promise.

serial.description: Batch sizes the runbook's hosts run in: a number, a percentage string, or a list of them.

tags.description: Tags every task in the runbook carries, as a play's tags do in Ansible.

type.description: Runbook-type discriminator. "ansible" is reserved and non-actionable today.

vars.description: The runbook's own variables, the widest scope; a block's or task's vars of the same name win.

title: Pleiades runbook
